build_coefficient_mapping: build a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m representations
create_complex_idx: create a function to get real and imaginary coefficient indices for a given order m in spherical harmonics
test_coefficient_idx: test the coefficient_idx method to retrieve pre-computed indices for a specific degree l and order m
build_so3_grid: build an SO3_Grid module to transform irreps to and from a 2D spherical grid representation
refactor_to_grid_from_grid: refactor the to_grid and from_grid methods to convert between irreps embeddings and grid representations
